protocol.title: Keirin Chat continuity / capacity-proof operating protocol v1

current_research_objective: Reach scientific validation 100% primarily through historical virtual-world simulation. A preregistered second 100-race temporal replication has now completed without retune and replicated substantial venue/circumference heterogeneity. Next priority is a fully independent-meeting replication, then scale-up toward the existing ~2000-race substrate before final live confirmation.

active_datasets_and_artifacts.finding: Venue/circumference heterogeneity replicated directionally: Aomori/Kawasaki remained relatively strong, Gifu/Yahiko weak, and exact 333.3m was again the weakest circumference group with 0/16 top1 in replication.

replication_comparison.important_negative_evidence: Toyama exact 333.3m temporal replication produced 0/16 top1 hits; this warning must be retained and not tuned away.

immutable_rule_summary: Historical virtual-world simulation is the primary path until final live confirmation (KR-016).
Offline simulation does not require live odds unless an experiment specifically tests odds.
Odds belong at live/manual purchase boundary.
Historical simulation uses PRE model fields only; target results/payouts are not predictor inputs.
Historical pages may be outcome-bearing; KR-015 prevents false prospective upgrades.
Exact circumference is preserved; no nearest-length coercion.
No guessed PRE fields, post-result cherry-picking, or confirmatory retune.
Venue/circumference subgroup findings require independent replication before operational adoption.
GitHub is canonical continuity state; chat is ephemeral.

latest_completed_experiments.result: 100/100 preregistered temporal replication completed; top1 35.0%; winner Top3 71.0%; log loss 1.67788; venue/circumference heterogeneity replicated directionally without retune
100/100 frozen and scored; top1 29.0%; winner Top3 65.0%; log loss 1.80859

exact_next_executable_actions: Build a fully independent-meeting historical replication universe with dates/meeting IDs disjoint from both existing 100-race batches; preregister selection before result scoring.
Use the fully independent-meeting batch to test whether Aomori/Kawasaki strength, Gifu/Yahiko weakness and 333.3m weakness persist; no subgroup retune before that result.

Then expand toward the existing ~2000-race substrate and characterize class/grade, finals-vs-qualifiers, solo-rider and line-structure effects with all subgroup definitions preregistered before scoring.

Only after ranking/probability stability is characterized, use historical odds/settlement data to optimize ticket count, minimum required odds and bankroll allocation; realtime remains final confirmation only.
progress_reason: Advanced from 89% because a preregistered, race-level-disjoint second 100-race replication completed 100/100 without retune and independently replicated the core heterogeneity finding. This materially strengthens evidence beyond the first 100-race discovery batch while retaining major negative evidence such as Toyama 0/16 top1.
